title: Integrate Elastic APM for full observability
description: Implement comprehensive Elastic APM integration into the commit-relay FastAPI application for traces, logs, metrics, and custom events

components.name: APM Client Setup
components.description: Create apm.py module with client initialization and graceful fallback

components.name: Middleware Integration
components.description: Add ElasticAPM middleware to FastAPI app

components.description: Configure Python logging with APM handler for trace correlation

components.description: Create utility functions for agent events, tool usage, relay completions

components.name: Configuration

acceptance_criteria: APM client initialized with environment variables
ElasticAPM middleware added to FastAPI app
Logging configured to ship to Elastic with trace correlation
Custom event tracking functions created and working
Exception tracking integrated in error handlers
Custom spans added to key operations
Verification in Elastic Cloud Kibana successful

Check traces appear with proper timing
Check logs correlate with trace IDs
Verify custom events appear in transaction metadata
